modules.name: MB/MF Mixture Weight
modules.description: Stage 1 values are a weighted combination of model-based and model-free Q-values.

modules.name: Eligibility Trace
modules.description: Stage 1 model-free values are updated by the stage 2 reward prediction error scaled by an eligibility trace.

modules.name: Stage 1 Choice Stickiness
modules.description: A bonus is added to the stage 1 logits for repeating the previous trial's stage 1 action.

modules.name: Stage 2 Choice Stickiness
modules.description: A bonus is added to the stage 2 logits for repeating the previous trial's stage 2 action in the same state.

slots.post_trial:
if s_idx != -1 and a2 != -1:
    stage2_stickiness_last_a2[s_idx] = a2

modules.name: Stage 2 Global Choice Perseveration
modules.description: Adds a bonus to the stage-2 logits for repeating the most recent stage-2 action, regardless of the state.

modules.name: Value Decay to Zero
modules.description: Unchosen Q-values in both stages decay towards 0.

modules.name: Value Decay to 0.5
modules.description: Unchosen Q-values in both stages decay towards 0.5.

modules.name: Value Decay and Init to Center
modules.description: Initializes Q-values to a center parameter and decays unchosen values towards it.

slots.init:
q_stage1_mf = np.full(2, center)
q_stage2_mf = np.full((2, 2), center)

modules.name: Stage 2 Value Decay to Zero
modules.description: Unchosen Q-values in stage 2 decay towards 0.

modules.name: Stage 2 Value Decay to 0.5
modules.description: Unchosen Q-values in stage 2 decay towards 0.5.

modules.name: Q-Value Initialization to 0.5
modules.description: Model-free Q-values for both stages are initialized to 0.5.

modules.name: Asymmetric Learning Rates
modules.description: Separate learning rates are used for positive and negative reward prediction errors.

overrides.stage1_update: q_stage1_mf[a1] += (alpha_pos if delta_stage1 > 0 else alpha_neg) * delta_stage1
overrides.stage2_update: q_stage2_mf[s_idx, a2] += (alpha_pos if delta_stage2 > 0 else alpha_neg) * delta_stage2

modules.name: Separate Learning Rates
modules.description: Uses distinct learning rates for updating Stage 1 and Stage 2 model-free values.

modules.name: Reward-Dependent Stickiness Stage 1
modules.description: Adds a bonus or penalty to the previously chosen stage 1 action's logits depending on whether the previous trial was rewarded.

slots.stage1_logits_extra:
if reward_dependent_stickiness_stage1_last_a1 != -1:
    logits_1[reward_dependent_stickiness_stage1_last_a1] += beta * (p_win_1 if reward_dependent_stickiness_stage1_last_r > 0 else p_lose_1)

modules.name: Reward-Dependent Global Stickiness Stage 2
modules.description: Applies a bonus to the stage 2 action chosen on the previous trial, with the magnitude depending on whether the previous trial was rewarded.

modules.name: Reward-Dependent State-Specific Stickiness Stage 2
modules.description: Adds a bonus to the Stage 2 action value of the previously chosen action if the same state is visited, depending on reward.

modules.name: Separate MB and MF Inverse Temperatures
modules.description: Uses distinct inverse temperature parameters for model-based and model-free values at stage 1.

modules.name: Separate Stage 2 Inverse Temperature
modules.description: Uses a distinct inverse temperature parameter for stage 2 choices.

modules.name: Motor Chunking Bias
modules.description: Adds a bias to the stage-2 logit corresponding to the same motor action chosen in stage 1 of the current trial.

modules.name: Direct Model-Free Update
modules.description: Stage 1 model-free values are updated directly by the final reward prediction error, bypassing the stage 2 value.

overrides.stage1_update:
delta_stage1 = r - q_stage1_mf[a1]
q_stage1_mf[a1] += learning_rate * delta_stage1

modules.name: Asymmetric Direct MF Update
modules.description: Stage 1 model-free values are updated directly by the final reward prediction error, using asymmetric learning rates.

overrides.stage1_update:
delta_stage1 = r - q_stage1_mf[a1]
q_stage1_mf[a1] += (alpha_pos_dir if delta_stage1 > 0 else alpha_neg_dir) * delta_stage1
overrides.stage2_update: q_stage2_mf[s_idx, a2] += (alpha_pos_dir if delta_stage2 > 0 else alpha_neg_dir) * delta_stage2

modules.name: Dynamic Value Decay
modules.description: Decays unchosen Q-values towards a dynamic target that tracks average reward.

modules.name: Counterfactual Updating
modules.description: Updates the value of the unchosen stage-2 action in the visited state assuming it would have yielded the opposite reward.

slots.update_extra:
if s_idx != -1 and a2 != -1:
    counterfactual_updating_cf_reward = 1.0 - r
    counterfactual_updating_delta_cf = counterfactual_updating_cf_reward - q_stage2_mf[s_idx, 1 - a2]
    q_stage2_mf[s_idx, 1 - a2] += alpha_cf * counterfactual_updating_delta_cf

modules.name: Learned Transition Matrix
modules.description: The agent dynamically updates its belief about the transition probabilities from experience.

modules.name: Stage 1 Action Bias
modules.description: Applies an intrinsic bias to the logit of choosing action 0 at stage 1.

modules.name: Transition-Dependent Perseveration
modules.description: A perseveration bonus is applied to the previously chosen stage 1 action, with the magnitude depending on whether the previous trial's transition was common or rare.

slots.stage1_logits_extra:
if transition_dependent_perseveration_last_a1 != -1 and transition_dependent_perseveration_last_trans != -1:
    logits_1[transition_dependent_perseveration_last_a1] += beta * (pi_common if transition_dependent_perseveration_last_trans == 1 else pi_rare)

modules.name: Shared Choice Stickiness
modules.description: Adds a bonus to the Q-value of the action chosen on the previous trial at the same stage, using a single parameter.
